entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, Joker... What do you want to do?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, sure thing. Make sure that you're[n]fully prepared.

entries.en: Ooh, I'm always down for a little bit[n]of dress up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heheh, roger that. I hope you're looking[n]forward to my appearance!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, I'm up for something[n]extraordinary! I hope you look[n]forward to my new appearance!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I see! Well, I guess I am pretty[n]good-looking as is!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You got it—I'll show you just how cool[n]I can look!
